title: Possible earlier Eneo subcontractor labor movement
notes: S007 is search-only and describes an Eneo subcontractor strike beginning 14 November 2022 that the Energy Minister later lifted; body details and end date were not verified. S006 reports a 21 January 2023 ASEELEC assembly about Eneo-related issues and talks but does not establish that it involved the same workers or continuous episode. Do not merge across months without further evidence.
